import slots = "./slots.qui"
import words = "./word_index.qui"

class GridState(string[] letters, int[] assigned, bool[] used)
    string pattern(slots.Slot slot)
        return [for position := slot.cells[] then letters[position]].join("")

    int[] .assign(slots.Slot slot, int id, string word)
        int[] changed := []
        for: index < slot.length
            position := slot.cells[index]
            if letters[position] == "."
                letters[position] = word[index]
                changed = changed.append(position)
        assigned[slot.index] = id
        used[id] = true
        return changed

    void .unassign(slots.Slot slot, int[] changed)
        for position := changed[]
            letters[position] = "."
        used[assigned[slot.index]] = false
        assigned[slot.index] = -1

class Attempt(slots.Layout layout, words.WordIndex index, local GridState initial, int min_score, int budget)
    state := initial
    best := initial
    nodes := 0
    backtracks := 0
    prunes := 0
    dead_ends := 0
    int[] sequence := []
    max_depth := 0
    failures := array(#layout.entries, fill = 0)
    string[] trace := []
    outcome := "unfillable"

    int[] candidates(slots.Slot slot)
        return index.candidates(state.pattern(slot), min_score, state.used)

    (int, int[]) choose_slot()
        chosen := -1
        int[] choices := []
        for slot := layout.entries[]
            if state.assigned[slot.index] >= 0
                continue
            int[] available := candidates(slot)
            if chosen < 0 or #available < #choices
                chosen = slot.index
                choices = available
        return (chosen, choices)

    int wiped_out_slot(slots.Slot slot)
        for crossing := slot.crossings[]
            if state.assigned[crossing] < 0 and #candidates(layout.entries[crossing]) == 0
                return crossing
        return -1

    string .search()
        chosen, choices := choose_slot()
        if chosen < 0
            return "complete"
        slots.Slot slot := layout.entries[chosen]
        if #choices == 0
            dead_ends += 1
            failures[chosen] += 1
            return "fail"
        for id := choices[]
            if nodes == budget
                return "abort"
            nodes += 1
            int[] changed := .state.assign(slot, id, index.ranked[id].word)
            sequence = sequence.append(chosen)
            int wiped := wiped_out_slot(slot)
            if nodes <= 10
                mark := if wiped >= 0 then "!" else ""
                trace = trace.append("{slot.label}={index.ranked[id].word}{mark}")
            result := "fail"
            if wiped >= 0
                prunes += 1
                failures[wiped] += 1
            else
                if int(#sequence) > max_depth
                    max_depth = int(#sequence)
                    best = state
                result = .search()
            if result != "fail"
                return result
            .state.unassign(slot, changed)
            sequence = sequence[0:<#sequence - 1]
            backtracks += 1
        return "fail"

    void .run()
        string result := .search()
        outcome = if result == "complete" then "filled" elif result == "abort" then "budget" else "unfillable"

    GridState final_state()
        return if outcome == "filled" then state else best

class Grid(string[] rows)
    height := int(#rows)
    width := int(#rows[0])
    string cells := rows.join("")

    int size()
        return width * height

    int cell_number(int row, int column)
        return row * width + column

    string location_text(int position)
        return "{position / width + 1},{position % width + 1}"

    bool is_open(int row, int column)
        return 0 <= row < height and 0 <= column < width and rows[row][column] != "#"

    bool is_given(int position)
        return cells[position] != "#" and cells[position] != "."

    int[] white_cells()
        return [for position := (0:<size())[] if cells[position] != "#" then position]

    int asymmetric_cell(string symmetry)
        for: row < height
            for: column < width
                other_row := if symmetry == "rot180" then height - row - 1 else row
                other_column := width - column - 1
                if is_open(row, column) != is_open(other_row, other_column)
                    return cell_number(row, column)
        return -1

    int component_count()
        seen := array(nat(size()), fill = false)
        count := 0
        for start := white_cells()[]
            if seen[start]
                continue
            count += 1
            seen[start] = true
            int[] stack := [start]
            while #stack != 0
                position := stack[-1]
                stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
                row := position / width
                column := position % width
                for offset := [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]][]
                    int next_row := row + offset[0]
                    int next_column := column + offset[1]
                    if is_open(next_row, next_column)
                        int neighbor := cell_number(next_row, next_column)
                        if not seen[neighbor]
                            seen[neighbor] = true
                            stack = stack.append(neighbor)
        return count

import math
import grid = "./grid.qui"
import slots = "./slots.qui"
import words = "./word_index.qui"
import filler = "./filler.qui"
import render = "./render.qui"

const alphabet := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"

class Settings(int node_budget, int min_score, string symmetry, int relax_step, int weak_score)
class Block(string name, string[] options, string[] rows)
class Issue(int line, string reason)
class Duplicate(int line, string word, int first)
class InvalidTemplate(string name, string reason)

string[] read_lines(string name)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + name))
    string[] lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

bool ignored(string line)
    return line == "" or line[0] == "#"

bool contains_name(string[] names, string target)
    for name := names[]
        if name == target
            return true
    return false

bool valid_name(string name)
    if not (1 <= #name <= 20)
        return false
    for code := name.codepoints()[]
        if not ((97 <= code <= 122) or (48 <= code <= 57) or code == 95)
            return false
    return true

bool valid_row(string row, int width)
    if not (3 <= #row <= 15) or int(#row) != width
        return false
    for code := row.codepoints()[]
        if code != 46 and code != 35 and not (65 <= code <= 90)
            return false
    return true

string joined(string[] values, string separator)
    return if #values == 0 then "-" else values.join(separator)

Settings read_settings()
    map<string, string> values
    for line := read_lines("params.txt")[]
        if not ignored(line)
            parts := line.split(" ")
            .values.set(parts[0], parts[1])
    keys := ["node_budget", "min_score", "symmetry", "relax_step", "weak_score"]
    string[] parsed := []
    for key := keys[]
        match values.get(key)
            string value
                parsed = parsed.append(value)
            none
                void
    return Settings(int(parsed[0]), int(parsed[1]), parsed[2], int(parsed[3]), int(parsed[4]))

Block[] read_blocks()
    Block[] blocks := []
    inside := false
    current := Block("", [], [])
    for line := read_lines("templates.txt")[]
        if not inside
            if #line >= 9 and line[0:<9] == "TEMPLATE "
                current = Block(line[9:<#line], [], [])
                inside = true
        elif line == "END"
            blocks = blocks.append(current)
            inside = false
        elif #line.split(" ") > 1
            current.options = current.options.append(line)
        else
            current.rows = current.rows.append(line)
    return blocks

class WordList(local string[] source_lines)
    line_count := int(#source_lines)
    scores := map<string, int>()
    first_lines := map<string, int>()
    Issue[] invalid := []
    Duplicate[] duplicates := []
    for: position < line_count
        local line := source_lines[position]
        match words.word_line_error(line)
            string reason
                invalid = invalid.append(Issue(position + 1, reason))
                continue
            none
                void
        local parts := line.split(" ")
        local word := parts[0]
        match first_lines.get(word)
            int first
                duplicates = duplicates.append(Duplicate(position + 1, word, first))
            none
                .scores.set(word, int(parts[1]))
                .first_lines.set(word, position + 1)
    index := words.WordIndex(scores)

    string[] report_lines()
        result := ["WORDLIST lines={line_count} valid={#index.ranked} invalid={#invalid} duplicates={#duplicates}"]
        for issue := invalid[]
            result = result.append("invalid {issue.line} {issue.reason}")
        for duplicate := duplicates[]
            result = result.append("duplicate {duplicate.line} {duplicate.word} first={duplicate.first}")
        for: 3 <= length <= 15
            int[] bucket := index.words_of_length(length)
            if #bucket == 0
                continue
            int total := [for id := bucket[] then index.ranked[id].score].sum()
            words.Entry best := index.ranked[bucket[0]]
            result = result.append("length {length} words={#bucket} average={render.decimal(total, int(#bucket), 2)} best={best.word}:{best.score}")
        bands := ["bands"]
        for: band < 5
            low := band * 20 + 1
            high := (band + 1) * 20
            count := [for entry := index.ranked[] if low <= entry.score <= high then 1].sum()
            bands = bands.append("{low}-{high}={count}")
        result = result.append(bands.join(" "))
        string[] top := []
        for: position < 5
            top = top.append("{index.ranked[position].word}:{index.ranked[position].score}")
        result = result.append("top " + top.join(" "))
        int64[] letter_order := []
        for: letter < 26
            count := 0
            for entry := index.ranked[]
                if entry.word.contains(alphabet[letter])
                    count += 1
            letter_order = letter_order.append(int64(count * 32 + letter))
        sorted_letters := letter_order.sorted()
        string[] rare := []
        for: position < 5
            key := int(sorted_letters[position])
            rare = rare.append("{alphabet[key % 32]}:{key / 32}")
        return result.append("rare_letters " + rare.join(" "))

class Clue(string word, int number, string text)
    uses := 0

class ClueBook(local string[] source_lines, words.WordIndex index)
    entries := 0
    added := 0
    Issue[] invalid := []
    Issue[] unknown := []
    Clue[] clues := []
    local int[] empty := []
    int[][] by_word := array(#index.ranked, fill = empty)
    for: position < int(#source_lines)
        local line := source_lines[position]
        if ignored(line)
            continue
        entries += 1
        match words.clue_line_error(line)
            string reason
                invalid = invalid.append(Issue(position + 1, reason))
                continue
            none
                void
        local parts := line.split("|")
        local id := index.id_of(parts[0])
        if id < 0
            unknown = unknown.append(Issue(position + 1, parts[0]))
        else
            local clue_index := int(#clues)
            clues = clues.append(Clue(parts[0], int(#by_word[id]) + 1, parts[1]))
            by_word[id] = by_word[id].append(clue_index)
            added += 1

    string | none .choose(int id)
        if #by_word[id] == 0
            return none
        chosen := by_word[id][0]
        for candidate := by_word[id][]
            if clues[candidate].uses < clues[chosen].uses
                chosen = candidate
        clues[chosen].uses += 1
        return clues[chosen].text

    string[] report_lines()
        word_count := [for bucket := by_word[] if #bucket > 0 then 1].sum()
        result := ["CLUES entries={entries} valid={added} invalid={#invalid} unknown={#unknown} words={word_count}"]
        for issue := invalid[]
            result = result.append("clue_invalid {issue.line} {issue.reason}")
        for issue := unknown[]
            result = result.append("clue_unknown {issue.line} {issue.reason}")
        used_count := [for clue := clues[] if clue.uses >= 1 then 1].sum()
        repeated_count := [for clue := clues[] if clue.uses >= 2 then 1].sum()
        result = result.append("CLUE_USE used={used_count} unused={int(#clues) - used_count} repeated={repeated_count}")
        for word := index.scores.keys().sorted()[]
            for clue_index := by_word[index.id_of(word)][]
                clue := clues[clue_index]
                if clue.uses >= 2
                    result = result.append("repeated {word} clue={clue.number} uses={clue.uses}")
        return result

int total_score(filler.GridState state, words.WordIndex index)
    total := 0
    for id := state.assigned[]
        if id >= 0
            total += index.ranked[id].score
    return total

string slot_entry(slots.Slot slot, filler.GridState state, words.WordIndex index)
    words.Entry entry := index.ranked[state.assigned[slot.index]]
    return "{slot.label}:{entry.word}:{entry.score}"

int[] occurring_lengths(slots.Layout layout)
    int[] result := []
    for: 3 <= length <= 15
        for slot := layout.entries[]
            if slot.length == length
                result = result.append(length)
                break
    return result

int[] highlighted(int[] values, bool[] eligible, bool descending)
    stride := int(#values) + 1
    maximum := values.max()
    int64[] keys := []
    for: position < int(#values)
        if eligible[position]
            primary := if descending then maximum - values[position] else values[position]
            keys = keys.append(int64(primary * stride + position))
    int[] result := []
    for key := keys.sorted()[]
        if #result == 3
            break
        result = result.append(int(key) % stride)
    return result

class ValidTemplate(string name, grid.Grid board, slots.Layout layout, filler.GridState initial, bool[] theme_slots, int initial_minimum, int budget, string required_symmetry, filler.Attempt[] attempts, string[] chosen)
    filler.Attempt final_attempt := attempts[-1]
    filler.GridState state := final_attempt.final_state()

    bool is_filled()
        return final_attempt.outcome == "filled"

    string[] grid_paragraph()
        result := ["TEMPLATE {name}", "outcome={final_attempt.outcome} attempts={#attempts} min_score={final_attempt.min_score}"]
        return result.concat(render.grid_lines(board, state.letters)).append("numbers").concat(render.number_lines(layout))

    string[] clue_paragraph(words.WordIndex index)
        result := ["TEMPLATE {name}"]
        clued := 0
        missing := 0
        unfilled := 0
        for across := [true, false][]
            slots.Slot[] group := [for slot := layout.entries[] if slot.across == across then slot]
            if #group > 0
                result = result.append(if across then "ACROSS" else "DOWN")
            for slot := group[]
                id := state.assigned[slot.index]
                if id < 0
                    unfilled += 1
                    result = result.append(render.list_line(slot, "(unfilled)", state.pattern(slot), "-", false))
                else
                    clue := chosen[slot.index]
                    if clue == ""
                        missing += 1
                        clue = "(no clue)"
                    else
                        clued += 1
                    result = result.append(render.list_line(slot, clue, index.ranked[id].word, "{index.ranked[id].score}", theme_slots[slot.index]))
        return result.append("clued={clued} missing={missing} unfilled={unfilled}")

    string grid_summary()
        white := int(#board.white_cells())
        black := board.size() - white
        givens := [for position := board.white_cells()[] if board.is_given(position) then 1].sum()
        string[] holding := []
        for symmetry := ["rot180", "mirror"][]
            if board.asymmetric_cell(symmetry) < 0
                holding = holding.append(symmetry)
        symmetry_text := if #holding == 0 then "none" else holding.join(",")
        return "grid size={board.width}x{board.height} blocks={black} white={white} density={render.decimal(100 * black, board.size(), 1)} givens={givens} required={required_symmetry} symmetry={symmetry_text}"

    string slot_summary()
        int[] lengths := [for slot := layout.entries[] then slot.length]
        across := [for slot := layout.entries[] if slot.across then 1].sum()
        total := int(#layout.entries)
        string[] counts := []
        for length := occurring_lengths(layout)[]
            count := [for value := lengths[] if value == length then 1].sum()
            counts = counts.append("{length}:{count}")
        unchecked := [for position := board.white_cells()[] if layout.owner_count(position) == 1 then 1].sum()
        return "slots across={across} down={total - across} total={total} lengths={counts.join(",")} avg_length={render.decimal(lengths.sum(), total, 2)} longest={lengths.max()} unchecked={unchecked}"

    string coverage_line(words.WordIndex index)
        string[] parts := []
        for length := occurring_lengths(layout)[]
            count := [for id := index.words_of_length(length)[] if index.ranked[id].score >= initial_minimum then 1].sum()
            parts = parts.append("{length}:{count}")
        return "coverage " + parts.join(" ")

    string tightest_line(words.WordIndex index)
        counts := array(#layout.entries, fill = 0)
        eligible := array(#layout.entries, fill = false)
        for slot := layout.entries[]
            if not theme_slots[slot.index]
                counts[slot.index] = int(#index.candidates(initial.pattern(slot), initial_minimum, initial.used))
                eligible[slot.index] = true
        parts := [for id := highlighted(counts, eligible, false)[] then "{layout.entries[id].label}:{counts[id]}"]
        return "tightest " + joined(parts, " ")

    string hotspots_line()
        eligible := [for count := final_attempt.failures[] then count > 0]
        parts := [for id := highlighted(final_attempt.failures, eligible, true)[] then "{layout.entries[id].label}:{final_attempt.failures[id]}"]
        return "hotspots " + joined(parts, " ")

    string worst_crossing(words.WordIndex index)
        worst := -1
        worst_sum := 0
        for position := board.white_cells()[]
            int across := layout.across_slot[position]
            int down := layout.down_slot[position]
            if across < 0 or down < 0
                continue
            int combined := index.ranked[state.assigned[across]].score + index.ranked[state.assigned[down]].score
            if worst < 0 or combined < worst_sum
                worst = position
                worst_sum = combined
        if worst < 0
            return "-"
        slots.Slot across := layout.entries[layout.across_slot[worst]]
        slots.Slot down := layout.entries[layout.down_slot[worst]]
        string across_word := index.ranked[state.assigned[across.index]].word
        string down_word := index.ranked[state.assigned[down.index]].word
        return "{board.location_text(worst)} {across.label}:{across_word}+{down.label}:{down_word}={worst_sum}"

    string[] quality_lines(words.WordIndex index, int weak_score)
        total := total_score(state, index)
        weakest := 0
        string[] weak := []
        for slot := layout.entries[]
            int score := index.ranked[state.assigned[slot.index]].score
            if score < index.ranked[state.assigned[weakest]].score
                weakest = slot.index
            if score < weak_score
                weak = weak.append(slot_entry(slot, state, index))
        present := array(26, fill = false)
        points := [1, 3, 3, 2, 1, 4, 2, 4, 1, 8, 5, 1, 3, 1, 1, 3, 10, 1, 1, 1, 1, 4, 4, 8, 4, 10]
        total_points := 0
        for position := board.white_cells()[]
            int letter := state.letters[position].codepoints()[0] - 65
            present[letter] = true
            total_points += points[letter]
        missing := ""
        for: letter < 26
            if not present[letter]
                missing += alphabet[letter]
        distinct_count := [for found := present[] if found then 1].sum()
        pangram := if missing == "" then "yes" else "no"
        return [
            "quality total={total} average={render.decimal(total, int(#layout.entries), 2)} weakest={slot_entry(layout.entries[weakest], state, index)} weak={joined(weak, ",")}",
            "letters distinct={distinct_count} pangram={pangram} missing={if missing == "" then "-" else missing} scrabble={render.decimal(total_points, int(#board.white_cells()), 2)} worst_crossing={worst_crossing(index)}",
        ]

    string partial_line(words.WordIndex index)
        assigned_count := [for id := state.assigned[] if id >= 0 then 1].sum()
        lettered := [for position := board.white_cells()[] if state.letters[position] != "." then 1].sum()
        string[] blocked := []
        for slot := layout.entries[]
            if state.assigned[slot.index] < 0 and #index.candidates(state.pattern(slot), final_attempt.min_score, state.used) == 0
                blocked = blocked.append(slot.label)
        return "partial assigned={assigned_count}/{#layout.entries} letters={lettered}/{#board.white_cells()} blocked={joined(blocked, ",")}"

    string[] stats_paragraph(words.WordIndex index, int weak_score)
        string[] result := ["TEMPLATE {name}", grid_summary(), slot_summary()]
        themes := [for slot := layout.entries[] if theme_slots[slot.index] then slot_entry(slot, state, index)]
        if #themes > 0
            result = result.append("themes " + themes.join(" "))
        result = result.append(coverage_line(index)).append(tightest_line(index))
        for: position < int(#attempts)
            attempt := attempts[position]
            result = result.append("attempt {position + 1} min_score={attempt.min_score} budget={attempt.budget} outcome={attempt.outcome} nodes={attempt.nodes} backtracks={attempt.backtracks} prunes={attempt.prunes} dead_ends={attempt.dead_ends} max_depth={attempt.max_depth}")
        result = result.append("trace " + joined(final_attempt.trace, " ")).append(hotspots_line())
        if is_filled()
            string[] order := [for id := final_attempt.sequence[] then layout.entries[id].label]
            result = result.append("order " + joined(order, " ")).concat(quality_lines(index, weak_score))
        else
            result = result.append(partial_line(index))
        return result

InvalidTemplate | ValidTemplate process_template(Block block, Settings settings, words.WordIndex index, ClueBook &clue_book, string[] earlier_names)
    if not valid_name(block.name)
        return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "bad name")
    if contains_name(earlier_names, block.name)
        return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "duplicate name")
    budget := settings.node_budget
    minimum := settings.min_score
    symmetry := settings.symmetry
    string[] themes := []
    string[] seen_options := []
    for: position < int(#block.options)
        line := block.options[position]
        key := line.split(" ")[0]
        value := line[#key + 1:<#line]
        valid := true
        if key == "theme"
            valid = words.valid_word(value) and not contains_name(themes, value)
            if valid
                themes = themes.append(value)
        elif contains_name(seen_options, key)
            valid = false
        elif key == "node_budget" and words.valid_integer(value, 1, 100000)
            budget = int(value)
        elif key == "min_score" and words.valid_integer(value, 1, 100)
            minimum = int(value)
        elif key == "symmetry" and contains_name(["rot180", "mirror", "none"], value)
            symmetry = value
        else
            valid = false
        if not valid
            return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "bad option {position + 1}")
        seen_options = seen_options.append(key)
    if not (3 <= #block.rows <= 15)
        return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "bad height")
    for: position < int(#block.rows)
        if not valid_row(block.rows[position], int(#block.rows[0]))
            return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "bad row {position + 1}")
    board := grid.Grid(block.rows)
    if symmetry != "none"
        asymmetric := board.asymmetric_cell(symmetry)
        if asymmetric >= 0
            return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "asymmetric at {board.location_text(asymmetric)}")
    components := board.component_count()
    if components != 1
        return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "disconnected components={components}")
    match slots.short_run_error(board)
        string reason
            return InvalidTemplate(block.name, reason)
        none
            void
    layout := slots.Layout(board)
    orphan := layout.orphan_cell()
    if orphan >= 0
        return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "orphan cell {board.location_text(orphan)}")
    letters := [for position := (0:<board.size())[] then board.cells[position]]
    initial := filler.GridState(letters, array(#layout.entries, fill = -1), array(#index.ranked, fill = false))
    theme_slots := array(#layout.entries, fill = false)
    for: position < int(#themes)
        id := index.id_of(themes[position])
        if id < 0
            return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "unknown theme {position + 1}")
        chosen := -1
        for slot := layout.entries[]
            if initial.assigned[slot.index] < 0 and slot.length == int(#themes[position]) and words.matches(themes[position], initial.pattern(slot))
                chosen = slot.index
                break
        if chosen < 0
            return InvalidTemplate(block.name, "theme {position + 1} does not fit")
        .initial.assign(layout.entries[chosen], id, themes[position])
        theme_slots[chosen] = true
    filler.Attempt[] attempts := []
    attempt_minimum := minimum
    while true
        attempt := filler.Attempt(layout, index, initial, attempt_minimum, budget)
        .attempt.run()
        attempts = attempts.append(attempt)
        if attempt.outcome == "filled" or settings.relax_step < 1 or attempt_minimum <= 1
            break
        attempt_minimum = math.max(attempt_minimum - settings.relax_step, 1)
    final_state := attempts[-1].final_state()
    chosen_clues := array(#layout.entries, fill = "")
    for across := [true, false][]
        for slot := layout.entries[]
            if slot.across == across and final_state.assigned[slot.index] >= 0
                match .clue_book.choose(final_state.assigned[slot.index])
                    string clue
                        chosen_clues[slot.index] = clue
                    none
                        void
    return ValidTemplate(block.name, board, layout, initial, theme_slots, minimum, budget, symmetry, attempts, chosen_clues)

string[] ranking_paragraph(ValidTemplate[] filled, words.WordIndex index)
    ValidTemplate[] ranked := []
    for candidate := filled[]
        candidate_total := total_score(candidate.state, index)
        position := int(#ranked)
        ranked = ranked.append(candidate)
        while position > 0
            previous := ranked[position - 1]
            left := candidate_total * int(#previous.layout.entries)
            right := total_score(previous.state, index) * int(#candidate.layout.entries)
            names := [candidate.name, previous.name].sorted()
            if left < right or (left == right and names[0] != candidate.name)
                break
            ranked[position] = previous
            position -= 1
        ranked[position] = candidate
    result := ["RANKING"]
    for: position < int(#ranked)
        template := ranked[position]
        total := total_score(template.state, index)
        entries := int(#template.layout.entries)
        result = result.append("rank {position + 1} {template.name} average={render.decimal(total, entries, 2)} total={total} entries={entries}")
    return result

string[] reuse_paragraph(ValidTemplate[] filled, words.WordIndex index)
    string[] empty := []
    string[][] appearances := array(#index.ranked, fill = empty)
    for template := filled[]
        for id := template.state.assigned[]
            appearances[id] = appearances[id].append(template.name)
    result := ["REUSE"]
    for: int(#filled) >= count >= 2
        for word := index.scores.keys().sorted()[]
            names := appearances[index.id_of(word)]
            if int(#names) == count
                result = result.append("reused {word} {count} {names.join(",")}")
    return result

string[] summary_paragraph(int block_count, ValidTemplate[] valid)
    filled := 0
    unfillable := 0
    budget := 0
    attempts := 0
    nodes := 0
    for template := valid[]
        if template.final_attempt.outcome == "filled"
            filled += 1
        elif template.final_attempt.outcome == "unfillable"
            unfillable += 1
        else
            budget += 1
        attempts += int(#template.attempts)
        for attempt := template.attempts[]
            nodes += attempt.nodes
    return ["SUMMARY templates={block_count} invalid={block_count - int(#valid)} filled={filled} unfillable={unfillable} budget={budget} attempts={attempts} nodes={nodes}"]

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

void write_paragraphs(string name, string[][] paragraphs)
    string[] lines := []
    for paragraph := paragraphs[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(paragraph)
    write_lines(name, lines)

void fill_crosswords()
    settings := read_settings()
    word_list := WordList(read_lines("words.txt"))
    clue_book := ClueBook(read_lines("clues.txt"), word_list.index)
    blocks := read_blocks()
    string[] earlier_names := []
    ValidTemplate[] valid := []
    ValidTemplate[] filled := []
    string[][] grid_paragraphs := []
    string[][] clue_paragraphs := []
    string[][] stats := []
    for block := blocks[]
        match process_template(block, settings, word_list.index, &clue_book, earlier_names)
            InvalidTemplate invalid
                grid_paragraphs = grid_paragraphs.append(["TEMPLATE {invalid.name}", "error {invalid.reason}"])
            ValidTemplate template
                valid = valid.append(template)
                if template.is_filled()
                    filled = filled.append(template)
                grid_paragraphs = grid_paragraphs.append(template.grid_paragraph())
                clue_paragraphs = clue_paragraphs.append(template.clue_paragraph(word_list.index))
                stats = stats.append(template.stats_paragraph(word_list.index, settings.weak_score))
        earlier_names = earlier_names.append(block.name)
    stats = stats.append(ranking_paragraph(filled, word_list.index)).append(reuse_paragraph(filled, word_list.index)).append(summary_paragraph(int(#blocks), valid))
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_paragraphs("grid.txt", grid_paragraphs)
    write_paragraphs("clues.txt", clue_paragraphs)
    write_paragraphs("search_stats.txt", stats)
    write_lines("wordlist.txt", word_list.report_lines().concat(clue_book.report_lines()))

if main
    fill_crosswords()

string decimal(int numerator, int denominator, int places)
    scale := 10 ^ places
    rounded := (2 * numerator * scale + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
    fraction := "{rounded % scale}"
    return "{rounded / scale}." + "0" * nat(places - int(#fraction)) + fraction

string[] grid_lines(grid.Grid board, string[] letters)
    string[] lines := []
    for: row < board.height
        lines = lines.append(letters[row * board.width:<(row + 1) * board.width].join(""))
    return lines

string[] number_lines(slots.Layout layout)
    string[] lines := []
    for: row < layout.board.height
        string[] marks := []
        for: column < layout.board.width
            position := layout.board.cell_number(row, column)
            if not layout.board.is_open(row, column)
                marks = marks.append("##")
            elif layout.numbers[position] > 0
                marks = marks.append("{layout.numbers[position]:2.}")
            else
                marks = marks.append(" .")
        lines = lines.append(marks.join(" "))
    return lines

    return "{slot.number}. {clue} ({slot.length}) {entry} {score}" + (if theme then " theme" else "")

import grid = "./grid.qui"

bool starts_run(grid.Grid board, int row, int column, bool across)
    return board.is_open(row, column) and not board.is_open(row - (if across then 0 else 1), column - (if across then 1 else 0))

int run_length(grid.Grid board, int row, int column, bool across)
    length := 0
    while board.is_open(row + (if across then 0 else length), column + (if across then length else 0))
        length += 1
    return length

string | none short_run_error(grid.Grid board)
    for: row < board.height
        for: column < board.width
            for across := [true, false][]
                if starts_run(board, row, column, across) and run_length(board, row, column, across) == 2
                    direction := if across then "across" else "down"
                    return "short slot at {row + 1},{column + 1} {direction}"
    return none

class Slot(int index, int number, bool across, int[] cells)
    length := int(#cells)
    string label := "{number}" + (if across then "A" else "D")
    int[] crossings := []

class Layout(grid.Grid board)
    numbers := array(nat(board.size()), fill = 0)
    Slot[] entries := []
    across_slot := array(nat(board.size()), fill = -1)
    down_slot := array(nat(board.size()), fill = -1)
    local next_number := 0
    for: row < board.height
        for: column < board.width
            for across := [true, false][]
                if not starts_run(board, row, column, across)
                    continue
                length := run_length(board, row, column, across)
                if length < 3
                    continue
                start := board.cell_number(row, column)
                if numbers[start] == 0
                    next_number += 1
                    numbers[start] = next_number
                int[] cells := []
                for: position < length
                    cells = cells.append(board.cell_number(row + (if across then 0 else position), column + (if across then position else 0)))
                index := int(#entries)
                entries = entries.append(Slot(index, numbers[start], across, cells))
                for position := cells[]
                    if across
                        across_slot[position] = index
                    else
                        down_slot[position] = index
    for: index < int(#entries)
        int[] crossing := []
        for position := entries[index].cells[]
            int other := if entries[index].across then down_slot[position] else across_slot[position]
            if other >= 0
                crossing = crossing.append(other)
        entries[index].crossings = crossing.sorted()

    int owner_count(int position)
        return (if across_slot[position] >= 0 then 1 else 0) + (if down_slot[position] >= 0 then 1 else 0)

    int orphan_cell()
        for position := board.white_cells()[]
            if owner_count(position) == 0
                return position
        return -1

bool valid_word(string text)
    if not (3 <= #text <= 15)
        return false
    for code := text.codepoints()[]
        if not (65 <= code <= 90)
            return false
    return true

bool valid_integer(string text, int low, int high)
    if text == "" or text[0] == "0"
        return false
    for code := text.codepoints()[]
        if not (48 <= code <= 57)
            return false
    value := int(text)
    return low <= value <= high

string | none word_line_error(string line)
    parts := line.split(" ")
    if #parts != 2
        return "bad format"
    if not valid_word(parts[0])
        return "bad word"
    if not valid_integer(parts[1], 1, 100)
        return "bad score"
    return none

string | none clue_line_error(string line)
    parts := line.split("|")
    if #parts != 2
        return "bad format"
    if not valid_word(parts[0])
        return "bad word"
    clue := parts[1]
    if not (1 <= #clue <= 60) or clue[0] == " " or clue[#clue - 1] == " "
        return "bad clue"
    return none

bool matches(string word, string pattern)
    for: position < int(#pattern)
        if pattern[position] != "." and pattern[position] != word[position]
            return false
    return true

int score_of(map<string, int> scores, string word)
    match scores.get(word)
        int score
            return score
        none
            return 0

class Entry(string word, int score)

class WordIndex(map<string, int> scores)
    Entry[] ranked := []
    by_word := map<string, int>()
    by_length := map<int, int[]>()
    by_letter := map<(int, int, string), int[]>()
    local names := scores.keys().sorted()
    for: 100 >= candidate_score >= 1
        for word := names[]
            if score_of(scores, word) != candidate_score
                continue
            id := int(#ranked)
            ranked = ranked.append(Entry(word, candidate_score))
            .by_word.set(word, id)
            length := int(#word)
            int[] length_words := words_of_length(length)
            .by_length.set(length, length_words.append(id))
            for: position < length
                (int, int, string) key := (length, position, word[position])
                int[] letter_words := words_of_letter(length, position, word[position])
                .by_letter.set(key, letter_words.append(id))

    int[] words_of_length(int length)
        match by_length.get(length)
            int[] words
                return words
            none
                return []

    int[] words_of_letter(int length, int position, string letter)
        match by_letter.get((length, position, letter))
            int[] words
                return words
            none
                return []

    int id_of(string word)
        match by_word.get(word)
            int id
                return id
            none
                return -1

    int[] candidates(string pattern, int min_score, bool[] used)
        length := int(#pattern)
        int[] pool := words_of_length(length)
        for: position < length
            if pattern[position] != "."
                int[] bucket := words_of_letter(length, position, pattern[position])
                if #bucket < #pool
                    pool = bucket
        int[] result := []
        for id := pool[]
            if ranked[id].score < min_score
                break
            if not used[id] and matches(ranked[id].word, pattern)
                result = result.append(id)
        return result
